Procedure title: ID 6597899 - InterTradeIreland - All Island Entrepreneurial Leadership Pilot Programme for Women
Description: InterTradeIreland requires a Supplier for the provision of an All-Island Entrepreneurial Leadership Pilot Programme for Women. The purpose of the programme is to support women entrepreneurs and business leaders across Northern Ireland and Ireland to develop their leadership capability, strengthen business growth ambitions and enhance peer-to-peer networks on an all-island basis. The Supplier will be required to design, manage and deliver the programme, including participant recruitment support, programme delivery, facilitation, event management, mentoring and coaching arrangements, stakeholder engagement, monitoring and evaluation, and final reporting.
